decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (021-PE-00-99-DR-A-9901 Rev P01, 021-PE-BA-ZZ-DR-A-0801 Rev P02, 021-PE-BA-ZZ-DR-A-0802 Rev P02, 021-PE-BE-03-DR-0301 Rev P01, 021-PE-00-99-DR-A-9912 Rev P01, 021-PE-00-99-DR-A-9913 Rev P01, 021-PE-BA-00-DR-A-0006 Rev P02, 021-PE-BA-01-DR-A-0102 Rev P02, 021-PE-BE-00-DR-0001 Rev P05, 021-PE-00-99-DR-A-9914, 021-PE-BA-00-DR-A-0007 Rev P02, 130021/C/SK01, 021-PE-BE-ZZ-DR-0903 P01 (received 23/07/2013)
021-PE-00-ZZ-DR-A-0803 Rev C01, 021-PE-BE-03-DR-A-0302 Rev C01, 021-PE-BE-ZZ-DR-A-0801 Rev C01 (received 01/10/2013)
021-PE-00-99-DR-A-9911 Rev P04, 021-PE-BA-01-DR-A-0101 Rev P02 (received 03/10/2013)) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place (excluding demolition and ground preparation) until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details
Condition : 4 - The modular buildings labelled TA and TB on drawing 021-PE-00-99-DR-A-9913 P01 shall be removed from site prior to the 31st October 2014.
Condition : 5 - The measures contained in the Travel Plan shall be implemented as approved.

Condition : 6 - The electric car charging point shall be provided as specified in the application prior to the occupation of the buildings.  The electric car charging point shall then be maintained in working order for as long as the development remains in existence.
Condition : 7 - The cycle storage has shall be provided as specified in the application prior to the occupation of the development.
Condition : 8 - The development shall be carried out and used in accordance with the Delivery and Servicing Plan and Construction Logistics Plan submitted with the application.

Condition : 9 - During the course of the development:
a.	The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues.  
Before the development is first brought into use:
b.	The agreed scheme for decontamination detailed in the email dated 01/10/2013, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.
description: Erection of a  two storey rear extension.
